reviews.text:
I’ve been using this product for a while, and I’m very satisfied with the results. The texture is pleasant and easy to apply, and it absorbs well without feeling heavy or sticky. After regular use, my skin feels smoother, softer, and more hydrated. I also noticed that my overall complexion looks healthier and more refreshed.

The packaging is convenient and easy to use, making it a great addition to my daily skincare routine. Although everyone’s skin type is different, this product worked well for me and met my expectations. I would definitely consider purchasing it again and would recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable skincare product.
reviews.zh:
用咗呢款產品一段時間，效果好滿意。質地舒服易推，吸收得好，唔覺得厚重或者黐立立。持續用之後，皮膚feel到更滑、更柔軟、更保濕。整體膚色望落去都健康同有精神。

包裝方便易用，係我日常護膚routine嘅好幫手。雖然每人膚質唔同，但呢款產品對我好work，達到我嘅expectation。一定會考慮回購，亦推薦畀想搵可靠護膚產品嘅人。

reviews.text: I really like this product. It worked very well for my sensitive skin and didn’t cause any irritation or breakouts. My skin felt smooth and comfortable after using it, which is rare for me. I’ve tried many similar products, but this one stands out for being gentle and effective at the same time. I will definitely be purchasing it again and would recommend it to anyone with sensitive skin. I love it!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢個產品。佢對我嘅敏感肌非常有效，亦都冇造成任何刺激或者爆瘡。用完之後皮膚感覺滑順舒服，呢一點對我嚟講好難得。我試過好多類似嘅產品，但呢款喺溫和同有效兼備呢一點上特別突出。我一定會再回購，亦都推薦畀所有敏感肌嘅人。我好鍾意！

reviews.text: 別に特にいい感じはしないです。でも肌が潤うからいいです。
reviews.zh: 倒也唔覺得特別好用。不過皮膚會變得水潤，所以OK。

reviews.text:
Torriden Balanceful Cica Mask Sheet
This mask is a calming hero for irritated and sensitive skin. Infused with centella asiatica (cica), it soothes redness, reduces inflammation, and helps strengthen the skin barrier.

✨ The sheet is lightweight and adheres comfortably without slipping.
💧 Essence is gentle, hydrating, and absorbs quickly without stickiness.
🌱 Perfect for soothing stressed or reactive skin after a long day or breakout.

💚 A reliable mask to calm, hydrate, and restore balance to your skin.
reviews.zh:
Torriden Balanceful Cica Mask Sheet
呢款面膜係敏感肌同受刺激肌膚嘅鎮靜救星。加入咗積雪草（cica）成分，可以舒緩泛紅、減少炎症，同時幫助強化皮膚屏障。

✨ 面膜紙輕薄，貼面舒適，唔易滑落。
💧 精華液溫和保濕，吸收快，唔會黏笠。
🌱 經過漫長一日或者爆瘡之後，特別適合用嚟舒緩受壓或者容易反應嘅肌膚。

💚 一款值得信賴嘅面膜，可以鎮靜、保濕，同時幫肌膚回復平衡。

reviews.text: Having used this mask multiple times. The mask's soothing and hydrating properties work wonders, leaving my skin calm and nourished every single time. I love how it perfectly balances my skin.
reviews.zh: 我已經用過呢款面膜好幾次。面膜嘅舒緩同保濕效果非常出色，每次用完之後皮膚都感覺平靜又滋養。我好鍾意佢能夠完美咁平衡我嘅膚況。

reviews.text:
シートは薄くて、ペタつきなしです。
うるおいを与えて、このマスクは、肌にしっかり密着して美容液がたっぷり浸透する感じが本当に良いです。使い終わった後は肌がもちもちしていて、翌朝の化粧ノリも格段に良くなりました。乾燥が気になっていた肌が潤いを取り戻したようで、ハリ感もアップした気がします。
reviews.zh: 面膜紙薄薄嘅，唔會黏笠。提供滋潤，呢款面膜緊貼肌膚，精華液充分滲透，用起嚟真心好。用完之後皮膚變得彈潤，第二朝化妝嘅貼服度明顯提升咗。原本乾燥嘅皮膚似乎重新得到滋潤，感覺緊緻度都有所提升。

reviews.text: I have acne, sensitive, oily and slightly atopic skin. Because of acne, I tried this mask sheet and it works. My face skin iseasily irritated, so I used this twice a week. This product soothes the my skin's irritation easily.
reviews.zh: 我有暗瘡、敏感肌、油性肌同輕微異位性皮膚。因為暗瘡嘅關係，我試咗呢款面膜紙，佢係有效嘅。我塊面嘅皮膚容易受刺激，所以一星期用兩次。呢個產品可以輕易舒緩到我皮膚嘅刺激。

reviews.text: This is my first time trying Torriden masks and I really like this one! I’m not sure about the soothing aspect but this mask doesn’t dry up as fast as the ones I’ve tried before. The sheet is pretty thick but even if you reach 15-20 mins, it doesn’t feel drying.
reviews.zh: 係我第一次試Torriden嘅面膜，我真係好鍾意呢一款！舒緩方面我唔太確定，但呢款面膜冇之前試過嘅嗰啲咁快乾。面膜紙幾厚，但就算敷到15-20分鐘，都唔會覺得乾。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
